summary: T07 create-from-Apple verified: conditional PUT creates one timed event through EventService, visible in both Happening and DAV; duplicate (412), UID-conflict (409), and missing-precondition (428) creates fail safely; partial writes roll back and audit behavior is preserved. All 20 caldav_event_resource tests, 72 caldav lib tests, 11 event_api tests, and the full backend suite pass.
follow_up: T07 handoff asks to document normalization and transaction boundary; the create path uses a compensating delete (event_service.delete) rather than a single atomic transaction, so a failed create leaves both an event.create and an event.delete audit entry.
important_context: The DAV PUT create path commits the event via EventService first, then writes the caldav_event_resources mapping; on mapping failure it compensates by deleting the event. This is not a single atomic transaction — there is a brief window where the event exists without a DAV mapping, and a failed create records both event.create and event.delete audit entries plus two notification replanner sends.
